title: Scrubs

ai_content.desc_en: At General Hospital, a group of young doctors deal with medical emergencies and personal struggles, while trying to become the best in their field. They face challenges such as illness and death, and try to understand the meaning of life. In this journey, we see young doctors dealing with life's emergencies and personal struggles, and trying to become the best in their field.
